Minimum 2 years experience working as an Orthopaedic Technician

Incumbent performs clinical assessment and care management for patient and presents relevant patient data to the physician. Removes sutures, applies and removes casts and splints. Collects and records patient data, monitoring patient flow during clinic hours and provides patient information and instructions upon discharge. Travel to Ambulatory clinics will be required. Must demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served, i.e. neonate, pediatric, adult or geriatric and provide the care needed. Demonstrates positive attitude and excellent customer service to all.
Position will require some travel between sites.
Understanding of medical terminology
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Knowledge and abilities essential to the performance of the duties assigned to the position
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to regularly travel locally to Ambulatory Clinic off-site locations
Ability to maintain flexibility and work well in a constantly changing environment
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
